newsitem.title: ITALY: Compart 1996 net profit 96 billion lire.
newsitem.headline: Compart 1996 net profit 96 billion lire.

text.p: Italian holding company Compart, formerly known as Ferruzzi Finanziaria, on Tuesday reported a net consolidated profit of 96 billion lire after a profit of 11 billion lire in 1995.
At the parent company level, Compart SpA cut its net loss in 1996 to 44 billion lire from a loss of 350 billion lire in 1995, a company statement said.
Net financial net debt at end-1996 fell 14.9 percent, or 1.954 trillion lire, to 11.178 trillion lire from end-1995 levels, and for 1997 the group was optimistic.

On when the group plans a return to dividend payments, chairman Luigi Lucchini said: "I do not know, but there is optimism from the group's figures in the first months of 1997 and there is a continuing trend of improvement".
